panel.finding: Pareto retention and held-out skill validation are already explicit in EvoSkill.
RAKL's candidate distinction must concern scientific context and authority rather than generic multiobjective optimization.
Incompatible method assumptions should remain parallel local charts instead of forced comparison.
Blocking validity must precede non-blocking Pareto tradeoffs.
The method atlas can expand while bounded-context routing materializes only the selected operator contract.
Any claim that Pareto skill frontiers or evolving skill libraries are unique to RAKL must be removed.

sources.projection: Automated failure-analysis-driven skill discovery with a Pareto frontier of agent programs; skills are retained using held-out validation and some zero-shot cross-task transfer is reported.
sources.dedup_effect: PARETO_METHOD_FRONTIER and HELDOUT_SKILL_SELECTION are prior art, not standalone RAKL novelty.
sources.retained_external_practice: Use non-dominated multiobjective retention as one possible implementation primitive after RAKL validity/context gates.

sources.projection: Heterogeneous scientific resources are mined into validated executable skills carrying scope, I/O, environment assumptions, provenance and tests; the library expands, repairs, merges and prunes.
sources.dedup_effect: VALIDATED_EXTERNAL_SKILL_ASSIMILATION and EVOLVING_SCIENTIFIC_SKILL_LIBRARY are prior art.
sources.retained_external_practice: Keep explicit operational contracts and validation/provenance when converting external scientific know-how into executable operators.

sources.projection: Agent self-evolution is evaluated through reusable procedural ability transfer across multiple domains and backbones.
sources.dedup_effect: TRANSFER_AS_SELF_EVOLUTION_EVIDENCE is a close prior-art axis.
sources.retained_external_practice: Evaluate acquired method capability on held-out tasks/backbones rather than only the optimization benchmark.

sources.projection: Recursive self-improvement can include controlled evaluator/utility evolution across epochs.
sources.retained_external_practice: Permit evaluator-version changes only across explicitly scoped epochs while keeping each comparison's evaluator identity frozen.

retained_candidate_rakl_object.description: Methods are compared only within compatible atomic-fiber/context/assumption/resource/authority scopes; blocking scientific validity precedes Pareto tradeoffs; incompatible useful methods remain parallel local charts; evidence/negative history and transition witnesses remain attached.
retained_candidate_rakl_object.prior_art_refuter: A pre-cutoff method that provides semantically equivalent contextual comparison gating, authority-preserving method assimilation, non-forced coexistence and governed scientific promotion would narrow/refute this candidate contribution.
retained_candidate_rakl_object.empirical_refuter: If simple EvoSkill-style/global Pareto selection or static curation matches RAKL contextual assimilation on registered epistemic failure/cost metrics, the extra frontier structure does not earn runtime complexity.

saturation.reason: EvoSkill materially narrows the frontier novelty claim and leaves a more specific contextual/authority-scoped residual requiring adversarial review and frozen runtime benchmarks.
